name: llmwiki
description: Aria 구조를 옮긴 할일 비서 — 앱(aria-rn) · API(functions) · 공용 로직(packages/core) · Firebase

scripts.emulators: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:start --project llmwiki-minsu
scripts.test:api: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project llmwiki-minsu "node --test tests/api.test.mjs"
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:functions && npm run test:api
